system: A SaaS audit page and the estate's price registry: a kernel prices rented subscriptions from sourced vendor list prices and sets each against the estate organ that replaces it. No model runs, nothing is collected; the page keeps only its theme in the browser.

aiAct.why: No AI system (Art 3(1)): the build runs no model that infers its outputs, so the AI Act places no duty on it.

gdpr.why: No personal data is processed, so no GDPR / UK GDPR duty arises from the build.
